source:
For hundreds of years, the Wildwood Elezen have lived in the
relative safety of Eorzea's lush forests. With the formation of
Eorzea's governments, however, many Wildwood ventured forth
from the forests, drawn to the exhilarating cosmopolitanism of
nearby Gridania. There is minimal dimorphism between the two
genders, though males are generally considered to be milder and
more chivalrous in demeanor. Among their Duskwight brethren,
Wildwood Elezen are referred to as Greens, for their love of the forest.
target: Уже сотни лет диколесные элезены живут в относительной безопасности пышных лесов Эорзеи. Когда в Эорзее появились правительства, многие из них покинули леса, привлечённые бурной космополитичной жизнью соседней Гридании. Внешние различия между мужчинами и женщинами невелики, хотя мужчины обычно считаются более мягкими и обходительными. Сумеречные сородичи называют диколесных «зелёными» за их любовь к лесу.

source:

Duration: 5s
Executing Phantom Flurry again before its effect expires deals physical damage to all enemies in a cone before you with a potency of 600 for the first enemy, and 50% less for all remaining enemies.
Effect ends upon using an action other than Phantom Flurry or moving (including facing a different direction).
Cancels auto-attack upon execution.

source: In seasons past, this frightening festival was once a prime opportunity for mischievous voidsent to run rampant, that they might satiate their souls with mortal fear... These days, however, they have chosen to celebrate hand in hand with visiting adventurers.

source: After all that, perhaps some time to warm up and rest would be well advised. Fahrafahr has surely read the letter by now, so why don't you return to Shelter?
